explanations.answer: He comes to judge the earth
explanations.explanation: That's the reason, baker. The psalm says the rivers and mountains sing "before the LORD, for He comes to judge the earth" (Psalm 98:9). Even the mountains join in. Of all the things I've heard of a mountain doing, singing is the last one.
